notes: Live 2026-10-19: of 52 replies/originals, 37% opened with 'Fair point / Fair enough / You're right' and 27% said 'I'm voting YES'; many accounts sharing a template are easy to group. Drafts get a random opening style and rarely a vote declaration; a local gate rejects a draft whose opening, closing or stock phrase the team used recently.
opening_styles: Open with one concrete detail from your own daily life that bears on the point.
Open with the specific thing the author mentioned (a place, a service, a rule), not with a reaction to them.
Open by stating your point directly in your own words.
Open with a short, genuine question about the specific situation.
